subject: Post-signature boarding: HelixSolutions — Owners & technical preflight
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ivy Zhang <ivy.zhang@helixsolutions.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-signature boarding: HelixSolutions — Owners & technical preflight

Hi Ivy, Monica, Karthik —

Congrats again on getting the SOW signed. Quick internal note and handoff so CS has the context they need for kickoff next week. TL;DR: HelixSolutions (primary contact Ivy Zhang) signed the 12-month MVP bundle (RWI-2027-1145). Expected go-live target (internal) is 2028-01-31; initial traffic: ~10k daily inference units, 2 models (gen-chat-large, embed-lite). Key constraints: data residency in us-west, strict audit logging retention (13 months), and a single external SFTP for batch inference uploads.

Ownership proposed: Monica will be the primary Customer Success lead (post-signature owner) and Karthik will be primary technical steward for the first 30 days. I’ll remain on-thread for first two handoff meetings to surface any contract nuance or billing notes.

Immediate asks before kickoff:
- Monica: confirm proposed kickoff date/time zone availability.
- Karthik: can you validate whether Helix’s SFTP supports key-based auth and whether they can provide a sample file layout?
- Ivy/Helix ops: please upload the SOC 2 attestation + network allowlist to the shared Drive link (I attached SOW and a preflight checklist).

Attachments: Helix_MVP_SOW_v3.pdf (final), helix-preflight-checklist.xlsx (prefilled with items we expect).

Notes / internal callouts for Monica and Karthik:
- There is a negotiated onboarding credit tied to staged acceptance (Milestone 2); finance will require documented acceptance evidence for the incremental credit release.
- Support escalation: Bronze SLA for first 30 days, upgrade to Silver once acceptance criteria are met.
- Watch for an external partner (Acme ETL) who will push to the SFTP — their contact is not yet shared; we may need to loop in integrations.

Ivy — Monica will reach out with a 30/60/90 plan draft and a proposed kickoff slot. If any of the items above conflict with your internal timelines, flag now and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ivy Zhang <ivy.zhang@helixsolutions.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-signature boarding: HelixSolutions — Owners & technical preflight

Thanks Marcus — looping in a structured plan here so we can run the kickoff focused and avoid rework.

Ivy — great to meet you. I’ll be your CS lead. Proposed kickoff: Thursday, 2027-12-09 at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET. Agenda (45m): introductions, success criteria alignment, acceptance gates, technical preflight review, next steps & owners.

Preflight ask list (from helix-preflight-checklist.xlsx):
1) Network allowlist (CIDR ranges) + preferred region endpoints (we default to us-west-2).
2) SFTP access: host, port, username, auth method (key/pass), sample payload (CSV v2).
3) Test data sample (PII scrubbed) — ≤5MB.
4) SOC 2 attestation (pdf) and any supplemental security docs.
5) Names/emails for 2 technical contacts and 1 billing contact.

Karthik — can you confirm whether the embed-lite variant needs any special quantization profile for Helix’s target throughput? If yes, add to the checklist.

I will prepare a 30/60/90 onboarding draft and share it to the Drive link before the kickoff (expected by EOD 12/08).

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ivy Zhang <ivy.zhang@helixsolutions.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 13:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-signature boarding: HelixSolutions — Owners & technical preflight

Monica — quick technical notes before kickoff:

- Embed-lite: default quantization profile (int8) should be fine for their 10k DU/day. I’ll provision a canary workload on our staging pool to validate latency at 512 tokens. If their latency SLA needs <120ms tail, we should plan for a dedicated shard during peak.
- SFTP: key-based auth is preferred. If Helix can only do password auth, we’ll propose a short-lived, scoped account and run periodic rotation scripted via our integration runbook.
- Logging/audit: we’ll enable token-level audit logs and set retention to 13 months in the audit pipeline; I’ll add a note for any additional SIEM forwarding (Splunk/Datadog) they require.

Action items (technical):
- Karthik: spin a staging validation by 12/08 and post results to Drive.
- Monica: collect Helix test sample and creds prior to 12/09 kickoff.

I attached a short preflight checklist addendum to call out quantization & shard guidance.

-Karthik
From: Ivy Zhang <ivy.zhang@helixsolutions.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-signature boarding: HelixSolutions — Owners & technical preflight

Hi team — thanks for the clear breakdown and congrats on signing. Confirming the proposed kickoff on 2027-12-09 10:00 AM PT works for us. I’ve uploaded the SOC 2 PDF and the signed SOW to the Drive folder and shared with the emails on thread.

Quick answers:
- SFTP: Helix supports key-based auth; we will provide a deploy key and a sample CSV (schema v2) by EOD 12/08.
- Network allowlist: sending CIDR block list to Ops now; will share the doc link.
- Technical contacts: me (ivy.zhang@helixsolutions.com), Samir Patel (samir.patel@helixsolutions.com). Billing: finance@helixsolutions.com.

One ask from our side: can you include a brief runbook for fallbacks if the SFTP ingestion is delayed? The team wants to understand manual ingestion options and expected timeline for a patch.

I’ll join the kickoff and Samir will join the technical segment. Looking forward.

—Ivy
Director of Product Ops | HelixSolutions
